segment.source: Renders the questions a reader asks before paying — tax, invoices, currencies, contract length, what counts as a user — either as an accordion or as an open list in one or two columns. The accordion is native disclosure markup, so it opens without a line of script. Use it for: the foot of a pricing page, a billing help section, the small print of a rate card. Prefer 'Plan Change Explainer' when every question is about switching tiers, and 'Trial Terms Panel' when they are all about the trial.
